name: ts-forecasting-benchmark
description: A collection of time-series forecasting tasks assembled to evaluate forecasting models across a variety of real-world datasets and horizons. The benchmark measures predictive accuracy of point forecasts and short-to-medium-term horizon forecasts, comparing models using standard regression error metrics. It is intended to support evaluation of algorithmic choices, feature engineering, and cross-dataset generalization in time-series forecasting.
reputation: A practical, community-shared HF collection used by time-series practitioners and researchers for comparative evaluation; moderate adoption.
